The case: Sun (孙某) pretended to have a partnership with Xu (徐某) to supply coke to a steel company, got Zhu (朱某) to invest 1 million, forged Xu's signature, gave receipt, used money for other purposes, paid only 6k back, disappeared. This is fraud (诈骗). Also forging signature and receipt is falsification of documents? The typical label in dataset: "伪造公司、企业、事业单位、人民团体印章" for forging company seals. But here forging a signature of a person (徐某) and issuing receipt. Could be "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章" but that's for state documents. For private persons, maybe "伪造公司、企业、事业单位、人民团体印章" not applicable. Could be "提供虚假信息" but the dataset includes "提供侵入、非法控制计算机信息系统程序、工具" etc. Not relevant.

Maybe the appropriate crime is "诈骗" and "伪造公司、企业、事业单位、人民团体印章"? But not exactly. Could be "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章" is for official documents. Not.

But that case was about providing tool for fraud, not the fraud itself. Here Sun directly defrauded Zhu. So primary crime is fraud. Could there be also "伪造公司、企业、事业单位、人民团体印章"? Not present.

Check example: "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章" used for forging official seals. Not here.

Thus answer likely "诈骗". Possibly also "伪造文书"? But not in list.
